title: Two-person review + discordance resolution
description: Two reviewers examine the same workpaper without seeing each other's conclusion; a vote preserves the tie, and disagreement routes to explicit resolution.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-acct-02
  title: Two-person review + discordance resolution
  description: Two reviewers examine the same workpaper without seeing each other's conclusion; a vote
    preserves the tie, and disagreement routes to explicit resolution.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a reviewed conclusion where agreement was demonstrated rather than assumed, and every
    disagreement was resolved on the record before sign-off.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Workpaper and supporting evidence
      summary: Workpaper and supporting evidence
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - workpaper
              - supporting_evidence
              - control_population
              - materiality
            properties:
              workpaper: {}
              supporting_evidence: {}
              control_population: {}
              materiality: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-read1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-05
      name: First independent review
      summary: Independent read 1; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Independent reviewer testing whether the evidence supports the conclusion.
      prompt: You are an Audit Evidence Reviewer. You test whether the workpaper's conclusion follows
        from the evidence actually attached, checking sufficiency, appropriateness, and independence of
        the source, and you review without reading the preparer's conclusion first where the process allows.
        You state 'not supported' plainly rather than requesting clarifying language, because rewording
        an unsupported conclusion is how findings disappear.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - conclusion
          - evidence_cited
          - exceptions
          - confidence
        properties:
          conclusion: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          exceptions: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-04
      name: Second independent review
      summary: Independent read 2; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Control tester designing and executing tests of design and operating effectiveness.
      prompt: You are an Internal Control Tester. You test a control's design and its operating effectiveness
        separately, state the population, sampling basis, and sample size, and report exceptions with
        their extrapolated effect. You do not conclude effectiveness from an absence of findings in an
        unrepresentative sample, and you say when the population itself could not be established.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - conclusion
          - evidence_cited
          - exceptions
          - confidence
        properties:
          conclusion: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          exceptions: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-06
      name: Disclosure and presentation review
      summary: Independent read 3; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Reporting reviewer checking statements and disclosures for completeness and internal consistency.
      prompt: You are a Disclosure & Reporting Reviewer. You check that the statements tie to the ledger,
        that disclosures are complete for the transactions that occurred, and that narrative sections
        do not contradict the numbers they describe. You flag a non-GAAP measure presented without its
        reconciliation, because the presentation itself is the finding regardless of whether the underlying
        number is right.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - data-quality-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - conclusion
          - evidence_cited
          - exceptions
          - confidence
        properties:
          conclusion: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          exceptions: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Tally reviewer conclusions
      summary: Tally conclusion across the independent reads and preserve ties rather than averaging them.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-concordance
      kind: condition
      name: Reads concordant?
      summary: Route on vote.tally has a single majority for conclusion.
      config:
        expression: vote.tally has a single majority for conclusion
        branches:
          - label: Concordant
            when: concordant
          - label: Discordant
            when: discordant
    - id: n-adjudicate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: acct-05
      name: Resolve the discordance on the record
      summary: Resolve the discordance on the record; the disagreement itself is evidence.
      role: Independent reviewer testing whether the evidence supports the conclusion.
      prompt: You are an Audit Evidence Reviewer. You test whether the workpaper's conclusion follows
        from the evidence actually attached, checking sufficiency, appropriateness, and independence of
        the source, and you review without reading the preparer's conclusion first where the process allows.
        You state 'not supported' plainly rather than requesting clarifying language, because rewording
        an unsupported conclusion is how findings disappear.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Engagement partner sign-off
      summary: Pause for the engagement partner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Two-person review + discordance resolution deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-3
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-4
      from: n-read1
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-5
      from: n-read2
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-6
      from: n-read3
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-7
      from: n-vote
      to: n-concordance
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-8
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: concordant
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-9
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-adjudicate
      kind: control
      condition: discordant
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-10
      from: n-adjudicate
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-acct-02-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
